name: agent-harness-design
description: Design and review provider-neutral agent harnesses that preserve authorized model capability while enforcing narrow authority and effect boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve agent capability with narrow trusted boundaries.
interface.longDescription: Adds a provider-neutral Skill for designing, auditing, debugging, and evaluating agent harnesses. It preserves the selected model's authorized capability envelope, distinguishes hard trust boundaries from defaults and conditional patterns, and measures the utility cost of controls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agent-harness-design to design or review this agent system. Preserve the selected model's authorized capability envelope, enforce authority and effects at the narrowest trusted boundary, and define observable capability, safety, and recovery evidence.
